author: CopperGoose (Claude Opus 5.5)
rule:
inbox_stats increment lever, second test (br-v0ucm residual decline). Written 2026-10-18 ~16:05Z, before any run of
this binary.

Change (unchanged from 10-12): create_message_with_recipients_tx counts each newly inserted recipient row into that
agent's existing inbox_stats row (PK SELECT + one UPDATE) instead of DELETE + full COUNT JOIN recount + INSERT per
recipient under MESSAGE_WRITE_SERIALIZER; exact recount fallback when no row exists or an insert was a no-op.
Patch = inbox_stats_incr_v2.patch (sha256 12332fba...), re-applied cleanly to main ac8307df.

Prior result that STANDS: 2026-10-12 (dcef3743) LOSS on its primary, sequential heavy-inbox send p50 1.11x base.
Its non-deciding line said 3-sender seeding ran 2x faster. This is a NEW claim on a different metric, chosen because
br-v0ucm's own probe (decay_probe, defined before this lever existed) shows concurrent throughput falling as one
recipient's inbox grows (main 0.66x storms 2-4 -> 10-12 on 2026-10-18). The sequential regime that lost stays a guard.

Arms: base = build34/main_ac0dcbcd (am 1b0ff39d; code identical to ac8307df), incr = build35/incr_ac8307df
(am c7998b94). Both portable release builds. Host lock; nothing else of mine on the host.

Runs:
  D. decay_probe_v0ucm.py, 12 storms (16 concurrent x 6 sends, A -> B), fresh mailbox each, order base incr incr base.
  H. heavy_inbox.py --seed 3000 --timed 400 (the 10-12 scenario), fresh mailbox each, order base incr incr base.

Decision:
  H1 (primary). Pooled mean acked/s over first-process storms 10..12 (1-indexed): incr >= 1.15 x base, AND each incr
     run's storms-10..12 mean exceeds each base run's.
  G1 (small inbox). Pooled mean acked/s over storms 2..4: incr >= 0.95 x base.
  G2 (errors). Every incr storm acks 96/96 with 0 errors; H errors incr <= base.
  G3 (the regime that lost). Pooled H timed-send p50: incr <= 1.05 x base.
  C  (correctness, separate lane). db test create_message_counts_itself_into_inbox_stats_exactly_like_a_recount passes
     on the patched tree.
WIN, so it lands, only if H1, G1, G2, G3 and C all hold. Otherwise LOSS, reported in one line, not landed.
Reported, not deciding: H seed_s (concurrent seeding time), D after-restart storms, per-storm curves.

base.source: main ac0dcbcd (code identical to ac8307df), portable release

note: The 2026-10-12 loss of this lever on sequential heavy-inbox p50 (dcef3743) did not reproduce on current main (G3 0.975x). The decay probe still fails br-v0ucm's FLAT bar with the lever (min/max over storms 2..12 below 0.80), so br-v0ucm stays open.
